preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the swap and liquify mechanism, effectively stopping all automated liquidity additions and marketing fee distributions. This will prevent normal token transfers from triggering the swap mechanism, disrupting the contract's intended economic functions.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled() that controls whether the automated liquidity mechanism is active. By setting it to false, the owner can disable all swap and liquify functionality, preventing marketing fee distributions and liquidity additions. This is a classic owner privilege abuse where the owner can disrupt the token's intended economic functions.
attempts.attack_strategy: Become the contract owner (if not already) by overwriting the owner storage slot, then call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the mechanism.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Check if we're already the owner by calling the owner() function. 2. If not, use vm.store() to overwrite storage slot 0 with our address. 3. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false). 4. Verify the state change by checking the swapAndLiquifyEnabled variable.
